about: Words of the ordinary-life layer (engine/life_matters.py): what happens to people. Figures are in design_figures.json (lm_*).
illness_note: Design proposal (unsourced): for each illness, how often it comes (weight), its opening severity range, the severity it sheds in 30 days (recovery), and how much it can kill the old (deadliness).

parent_child: the way a parent was spoken to
friends: someone one of them is seeing

jobs_note: Which trades take a paid job from somebody outside the worker's family, what the job may be for, and what the customer must have (design figure lm_have_<needs>).

for: a side of beef for the freezer
bread and pastry for a christening
a private party in the back room
the groceries for a family gathering
a wedding dress and the suits
materials for a repair at home

stops_note: What stops an ordinary skip: a matter waiting on him of the `waiting` kinds, or of the `waiting_big` kinds when the sum reaches design figure lm_big_money_usd; and word of these things happening in his family. The rest waits and is told when the skip ends.
police_matters: who they were seen drinking with

illnesses.label: a growth the doctors do not like
